claims.text: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (Defossez et al., 2024): First real-time full-duplex speech-text LLM: parallel user/system streams, Mimi streaming codec (80ms frame), Inner Monologue; theoretical 160ms / ~200ms practice latency; open weights. Foundational latency methodology for G10.
